note: stores[].sha256 is the byte hash of the store file, taken from an unopened copy right before that copy is opened. Opening a store, a read-only query included, can change its bytes, so a copy is spent once opened: a reused copy no longer matches this value and a run on it is not comparable. A store derived from a pinned one (a filled copy, for example) is compared by content fingerprint, and the fingerprint output is kept beside the results. Eval stores live outside every repository, under _eval-stores/ at the workspace root (the parent of the Vinc checkout).
